_doc: Per-spec notes byte ceilings (JSON.stringify(spec.notes).length), enforced by test/reference/notes-budget.test.ts.
Only a NEW offender (>800 B, unlisted here) or a GROWN one (above its ceiling) fails. Philosophy: SHRINK this file —
when touching a listed spec, trim its notes (move business context to the DB detail tier: `ib reference detail set <cmd> --field detail`,
an authenticated CLI write, no deploy) and lower or delete its entry. Never raise a ceiling casually; a raise is a reviewed decision.
A listed spec that drops to/below 800 B (or is renamed away) FAILS the liveness guard until its entry is deleted, so the baseline stays honest.
